answer.reason: "Picture tiles" maps to the Bento Section component (BentoSection), which is described as a list of "Bento" cards for showcasing screenshots or graphics. Its BentoCards field is a nested grid whose items use the BentoCard content model. BentoCard has an Eyebrow, Title, Description, and a Graphic image attachment, which fits a tile with a large product screenshot. The other image-based option, GalleryImage (used by the Gallery "Images" component), is only an image plus caption in a shared grid, so it is a weaker fit for a tile in a picture-tile section. I did not save anything.
